description:
Open the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app. Navigate to the cancer drug 'Ribociclib'. Then find the co-medication 'Ondansetron' (likely under Anti-emetics or similar category). Select it to view the interaction result. 

Once the result is displayed, verify the interaction color code (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, or Grey). 

Create a text file at '/sdcard/interaction_result.txt' containing exactly three lines:
1. Ribociclib
2. Ondansetron
3. [The interaction color you observed]
